Flow.description: V7:: Dual form-factor version. Salesforce's Data Table screen component is not supported in the mobile app (its inner scroll region traps the touch gesture, so screens cannot scroll and visits cannot be submitted). This version keeps the Data Tables for desktop and adds a picklist (S03) and checkbox groups (S04, S06, S07 Services, S07 Collateral) for mobile. A new input variable vB_IsMobile drives component visibility and per-screen normalization; a wrapper flow launched by the mobile quick action sets it to true. Also re-applies the production V7 fix allowing blank Affiliation in Get Physician-to-Physician Providers.
